verdict_reason: Geometry validity now passes (it1 REVISE cause cleared: tessellation watertight at 12 settings in both frames). The remaining misses are scan->CAD max (2.348, chrome scan flap: scan wrong, CAD right), observable CAD->scan p95/max (unobserved pocket floor / bore floor that the ray test counts as observable) and zone Z4 scan->CAD max (same flap). None can be cleared by more geometry without new data (rescan or depth readings), so REVISE is not the right route; the miss is real, explained per region, and needs an owner ACCEPT-BAND or new data.
